sentences.en: The museum has some ancient artifacts out on loan until the end of the month.
sentences.zh: 博物馆借出了些古董展品，借期到本月末。

sentences.en: I'm reading a book out on loan from the library. It's really good!
sentences.zh: 我正在读图书馆借出的一本书。真的很好！

sentences.en: The company’s new equipment is currently out on loan to another department.
sentences.zh: 公司的新设备目前借给另一个部门使用。
